from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its case cause and title for task matching."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type classification: 民事/行政/刑事/国家赔偿/执行等")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
